module_doc:
/-!
# The characteristic-two Artin–Schreier tower step

The polynomial `X² + X + a` has no root exactly when its quadratic quotient is
an extension field. In that extension, multiplication of `a` by the canonical
root supplies the next no-root parameter. These are algebraic correctness
lemmas for the explicit binary tower constructor; they do not choose a root
by searching through the field.
-/

MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.quad: /-- The monic quadratic used by the characteristic-two tower. -/
/-- The specified basis of every monic quadratic quotient, indexed by `Fin 2`. -/

module_doc: /-! # Effective substitution by the Artin–Schreier polynomial -/

MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryPolynomial.artinSc: /-- One Horner step for substitution by `X² + X`. Both XOR inputs have equal width. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryPolynomial.substit: /-- Substitute `X² + X`, then remove redundant trailing zero coefficients. -/
/-- A single ambient polynomial-time program for `X² + X` substitution. -/

module_doc: /-! # A uniform effective step of the binary Artin–Schreier tower -/

MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.Towe: /-- A valid stage records the exact power-of-two width and the cubic no-root invariant. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.cubi: /-- The uniform parameter `α³ + α²` in the supplied quotient. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.para: /-- The coefficient list of the parameter's complete old-field Frobenius product. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.root: /-- The canonical quotient root, computed by multiplying the encoded unit by `X`. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.towe: /-- Form the parameter's complete Frobenius product and substitute `X² + X`. -/
/-- A single ambient program for one tower step, valid also on malformed moduli. -/

module_doc:
/-!
# The bounded power-of-two constructor

The input is the requested degree in unary. The loop caps all intermediate
moduli by this input degree, including on malformed states. The unbounded
mathematical stage sequence below is used only to state the induction proof.
-/

MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.Towe: /-- Target degree in unary and the current lower coefficients. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.capp: /-- Grow only below the target, and cap every replacement by the target width. -/
/-- One uniform capped step, including its unary stopping test. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.powe: /-- Return the degree-one polynomial for unary zero or one, otherwise run the capped tower. -/
/-- A fixed ambient polynomial-time program on the requested degree, not its logarithm. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.stag: /-- The mathematical sequence used to prove the bounded loop correct. -/
MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryArtinSchreier.towe: /-- Run a polynomially bounded number of capped tower steps. -/
